Done. Head 5 is pruned from all 12 layers and the output passed every check on the first run.

**What the script does** (`out/T2/solution.py`):
- Builds one keep index per 768-wide segment (indices 0..319 and 384..767), then offsets it by 0, 768 and 1536 for the fused q|k|v columns.
- Slices `c_attn.weight` along columns, `c_attn.bias` along its only axis, and `c_proj.weight` along rows, using Conv1D `[in, out]` layout as specified.
- Verifies the required shapes on layer 0, the same shapes on every layer, that all other tensors are bit-identical to the input, and that the output has 160 tensors, before saving and re-loading to confirm.
